description: This file defines a Java interface 'BankingCoreRestClient' that acts as a REST client for communicating with a core banking service. It uses Spring Cloud OpenFeign annotations to declare external API calls for retrieving account details and processing utility payments.

classes.name: BankingCoreRestClient
classes.description: A Java interface annotated with FeignClient to facilitate REST communication with the core banking service for account retrieval and utility payments.

methods.name: readAccount
methods.description: Retrieves account details for a given account number via a GET request.

methods.name: utilityPayment
methods.description: Processes a utility payment using a POST request with payment details.
